review:
I enjoyed it enough at first but there is too much repetiton and it's a touch unrealistic for my tastes (though I have no problem with super-natural elements). It was a good idea with great atmosphere but the game portion needs some improvement. I was going to give the game a positive review because it is free (and that counts for something, even though I have played similar free apocaylse virtual novels that I enjoyed more) but I am now running into a lot of bugs and my crowbar has been removed as an option.


Speaking of crowbars... I don't get what the big deal was. I wouldn't call them a "specialy" tool: we always had one growing up and at the current moment I have two or three different types. But the game treated owning one as a huge deal... But it's just like owning a hammer - at least, where I live in the USA, it is.

Очередное дерьмо про группы суицида и прочая ♥♥♥♥♥. Перед вами есть тупая пезда 14-16 лет, которая хочет убиться(разумеется пиздит, просто внимание привлекает). Этот тип педофил в ♥♥♥♥♥♥ шляпе , как у гудини, который мастерски наебывал людей, наебывает эту тупую пезду на еблю.Телка конечно ломается , ей нужны хачи, не как этот американец гудини. Ну этот гудини принимает решение устроить ей 50 заданий, на выполнение которые дается по дню.Эта тупая пезда соглашается и тут-то вы подключаетесь. Вы выбираете, во что вкачать силикон и ботекс. Какие презервативы лучше. Но в каждой концовке вас выебут в аналик, догадайтесь кто...

The Bottom of the Well nie wystarczy skończyć raz. To gra której tajemnice poznaje się przy kolejnych podejściach. 
Nie jest długa, historia jest ciekawa a wszystko razem dopracowane. Jak na darmowy tytuł wypada, według mnie, celująco.

It's free, easy (?) to play and oddly compelling. There's no flashy graphics, no complicated key combinations, the action is delivered as a narrative, only you decide from a list of options what our heroine (Alice) does next. Unfortunatly the choices I've made so far have resulted in her death, some more gruesome than others, but....It's free, did I mention that? 

Get it, try it, you have nothing to lose, except Alice's life.

[b]Pros:[/b]
- Many ways to die
- Atmospheric
- Simple
- Customizable character sheet
- Free
- Achievements

[b]Cons[/b]
- Finishing can be quite tedious
- What items are good/bad not clear

Personal Rating: 3.5/5
The Bottom of the Well, despite being short, turned out to be a surprisingly engaging and challenging little VN. For a free game, this is absolutely worth your while.
